snapshot.text: Public system with very high HIV prevalence but strong HIV progress, recognised as a global leader. Medicine shortages in public facilities are a public complaint, and Eswatini signed a $195 million health pact with the US.

priorities.title: US health pact
priorities.text: A $195 million agreement with the US to shore up the health system.

priorities.title: Epidemic surveillance
priorities.text: New epidemic surveillance guidelines were launched.
